name: CRYPTO_EMA_TREND_V1 — baseline parameter neighbourhood (example, non-runnable)
description: Phase 3 example research plan. NON-RUNNABLE AS COMMITTED: every entry in `datasets` below is an explicit PLACEHOLDER — `datasetFile` points at a file that does not exist in this repository, and `expectedDatasetHash` is a placeholder of all zeros, never a real SHA-256 digest. This repository has no established convention for committing large real market datasets, and this plan deliberately does not fabricate one. To actually run this plan: supply real (or your own synthetic-but-honestly-labelled) local candle dataset JSON files for BTC/ETH/SOL on the 1h timeframe, compute each one's real dataset hash with `npm run strategy:backtest` (any run against that file prints `dataset.datasetHash`) or `computeDatasetHash` directly, and replace the placeholder `datasetFile`/`expectedDatasetHash` values below accordingly. Everything else in this plan (the strategy pin, the parameter neighbourhood, the criteria) is real and meaningful as written.

notes: A modest neighbourhood around the baseline's own EMA20/EMA50/RSI14 parameters — never a wide or exhaustive search.

limitations: NON-RUNNABLE AS COMMITTED — see this plan's own `description` field: every dataset entry is a placeholder pending real local candle data.
